# CompatAir

> Source-backed, deterministic compatibility between air compressors, pneumatic tools and documented system components. Missing critical data always remains `insufficient_data`.

## Agent interfaces

- [MCP documentation in French](https://compatair.fr/mcp-documentation/)
- [MCP documentation in English](https://compatair.fr/en/mcp/)
- [Streamable HTTP endpoint](https://compatair.fr/mcp)
- [MCP health and active versions](https://compatair.fr/mcp-health)
- [UCP documentation in French](https://compatair.fr/ucp/)
- [UCP documentation in English](https://compatair.fr/en/ucp/)
- [UCP discovery profile](https://compatair.fr/.well-known/ucp)
- [UCP compatibility endpoint](https://compatair.fr/api/ucp/v1/compatibility/evaluate)
- [Full agent documentation](https://compatair.fr/llms-full.txt)

## Citation rule

Use the `canonical_url` returned by every MCP or UCP decision as the preferred CompatAir page. Keep `source_urls`, `method_version`, `catalog_version`, `observed_at`, `limitations` and `next_actions` with the result. Never turn `insufficient_data` into a positive recommendation. CompatAir is a decision and evidence layer, not a checkout or a generic product catalog.
